title: Emergency Phrases: English <-> Chinese (Simplified)
summary: Essential bilingual English and Simplified Chinese emergency phrases for on-screen pointing during communication barriers.
content:
Show this card on your phone screen and point directly to the phrase you need if language is a barrier during an emergency.

1. EN: Please help me! | CH: 请帮帮我！(Qǐng bāng bāng wǒ!)
2. EN: I need an ambulance and police (call 999 or 112). | CH: 我需要救护车和警察 (拨打 999 或 112)。(Wǒ xūyào jiùhùchē hé jǐngchá.)
3. EN: I am hurt / injured and bleeding. | CH: 我受伤了，在流血。(Wǒ shòushāng le, zài liúxuè.)
4. EN: I have a heart condition / I have diabetes. | CH: 我有心脏病 / 我有糖尿病。(Wǒ yǒu xīnzàngbìng / wǒ yǒu tángniàobìng.)
5. EN: Where is the nearest hospital? | CH: 最近的医院在哪里？(Zuìjìn de yīyuàn zài nǎlǐ?)
6. EN: I need clean drinking water and food. | CH: 我需要干净的饮用水和食物。(Wǒ xūyào gānjìng de yǐnyòngshuǐ hé shíwù.)
7. EN: The power and heating are completely out. | CH: 这里停电了，暖气也停了。(Zhèlǐ tíngdiàn le, nuǎnqì yě tíng le.)
8. EN: Is the tap water safe to drink? | CH: 这里的自来水可以安全饮用吗？(Zhèlǐ de zìláishuǐ kěyǐ ānquán yǐnyòng ma?)
9. EN: I urgently need my prescription medication. | CH: 我急需我的处方药。(Wǒ jíxū wǒ de chǔfāng yào.)
10. EN: Do you speak English? / Can someone translate? | CH: 你会说英语吗？/ 有人能帮忙翻译吗？(Nǐ huì shuō yīngyǔ ma? / Yǒu rén néng bāngmáng fānyì ma?)

Closing tip: Speak slowly, stay calm, and point firmly at the matching phrase on the screen. If verbal communication fails, combine pointing with clear hand gestures (such as pointing to your chest or medication) to confirm understanding.
